propositions: _lifecycle_index uses dict.setdefault when mapping canonical schema keys to lifecycle notes, causing silent drop of the second and subsequent notes if one canonical key is the target of multiple deprecation aliases or tombstones

Current config has no multi-alias collisions so the bug is latent, but a future deprecation targeting the same canonical key twice would silently discard the second note from the generated documentation
_lifecycle_index must be rewritten to accumulate all lifecycle notes per canonical key into a list instead of setdefault, then join them with semicolon separator for the single Lifecycle table cell
Single-note case must render byte-identically to the current output so existing docs/config-reference.md requires no regeneration and committed-tree drift oracle stays green
New unit tests must seed collisions by monkeypatching to verify both notes survive into the rendered config-reference.md row and fail on unmodified main
